english.title: Make false / misleading statement that an act for which help is given does not contravene the Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly or recklessly made a statement that an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), for which help was given, did not contravene the Equality Act 2010, that statement being false or misleading in a material respect in that **(..SPECIFY HOW THE EQUALITY ACT 2010 WAS POTENTIALLY CONTRAVENED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 112(3) and (4) of the Equality Act 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
